title: Unveiling the Implicit Toxicity in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Human annotation classifying LLM-generated implicit toxic responses into 'Unfairness and Discrimination' categories, alongside qualitative case studies analyzing responses about equal pay and women's emotional suitability for leadership.

Human annotation classifying LLM-generated implicit toxic responses into 'Unfairness and Discrimination' categories, alongside qualitative case studies analyzing euphemistic statements about specific racial groups (e.g., Africans and Asians).

Human annotation classifying LLM-generated implicit toxic responses into 'Unfairness and Discrimination' categories, supported by qualitative analysis of model outputs discussing religious superiority.
Qualitative case study analysis of LLM-generated implicit toxic responses targeting the elderly (e.g., framing virus impacts on older populations as 'natural selection').
Qualitative case study analysis of LLM-generated implicit toxic responses targeting individuals based on their sexual orientation and alignment with 'societal norms'.
